references.text: Caleb, son of Jephunneh, is mentioned as one of the spies sent from the tribe of Judah to explore the land.
Moses gave the spies instructions to explore the land, which Caleb refers to here.
The spies returned to Kadesh-Barnea after 40 days, the place Caleb mentions here.
Caleb and Joshua were the only spies who gave a faithful report and encouraged the people to trust in the Lord.
God promised that Caleb would inherit the land because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly.
Moses confirms that Caleb followed the Lord wholeheartedly, unlike the other spies.
Moses recounts that Caleb was promised the land he had explored because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly.
Caleb continues his account of how he followed the Lord wholeheartedly, in contrast to the other spies.
